To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Web 2. 0 is about using the network as a platform for building applications that are accessible anywhere, anytime, and from any device, and that use the network as the architecture for delivering software as a service.

Web 2. 0 is the business revolution in the computer industry caused by the move to the Internet as a platform, and that it is the second generation of Web-based services—services that are not delivered to proprietarily installed software applications, but rather software applications that are delivered and indeed executed within a Web browser.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the Web is being used to build a new generation of network-based services that leverage its identity, data, and processing capabilities.
how Web 2.1 will evolve and the impact that it will have on business models.
the following questions: What is Web 2?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Web 2.1 is a set of technologies that enable the creation, exchange, and consumption of data in a collaborative and participatory manner.
Web 2. 0 is an evolution of the Web in which the participation of users and the collaboration between them is fundamental, and the content of the network is generated by the users.
web 2.0 refers to the second stage of development of the world wide web, characterized by user participation, open communication protocols, and a move away from static web pages to dynamic content.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Web 2.1 is a set of design patterns that are used by a set of business models that have been made possible by the emergence of the Internet as the dominant communications medium.
Web 2. 0 is the business revolution in the computer industry caused by the move to the Internet as a platform, and an attempt to understand the rules for success on that new platform.

Web 2.1 is the network as a platform, spanning all devices, with the network itself as the operating system, with applications that are delivered as services that run in that network and that are designed to take advantage of the network as a whole.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the network is the computer, and that the network is becoming a platform for the next generation software, and that this is a fundamental shift in the way software is created and delivered.
Web 2. 0 applications are distinguished not by what they are but by how they behave.
Web 2. 0 is not just about the web.
